final: WITH a AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS acc_sum, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id=t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id=ac.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, acc_sum, txn_count, acc_sum * 1.0 / SUM(acc_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share FROM a ORDER BY (share IS NULL), share DESC LIMIT 10
